SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN student s ON sh.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN homework h ON sh.homeworkid = h.homeworkid
AND (s.studentname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT sh.id, sh.homeworkid, sh.studentid, sh.content, sh.filepath, sh.score, sh.comment, sh.status, sh.submittime, sh.gradetime, sh.grading_status, s.studentno, s.studentname, h.title as homeworktitle, h.content as homeworkcontent, h.type as homeworktype, h.deadline, c.courseid, c.coursename, t.teachername FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN student s ON sh.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN homework h ON sh.homeworkid = h.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON h.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE sh.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN student s ON sh.studentid = s.studentid WHERE sh.homeworkid = #{homeworkid}
AND (s.studentname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.studentno LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT sh.id, sh.homeworkid, sh.studentid, sh.content, sh.filepath, sh.score, sh.comment, sh.status, sh.submittime, sh.gradetime, sh.grading_status, h.title as homeworktitle, c.coursename FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN homework h ON sh.homeworkid = h.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid WHERE sh.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND sh.studentid = #{studentid} LIMIT 1
